name: 岩隐寺（暂名；候选栖露岩寺）
status: research_only; no scene has been built; see acceptance criteria in PLAN.md
source_of_truth: this pack; numbers marked 推算/提案 come from OSM/SRTM/公开文字 and are not survey data
units: metres; +y up; +x east (out of the cave, toward the lake); +z south; origin at the centre of the cave mouth floor

zones.name: 湖面远望（只作机位，不是可行走区）
zones.floor: lake surface about 275 m (normal water level of Chitan reservoir, S17)
zones.collision: not walkable; the boat/wharf is a camera platform only

zones.name: 林间窄路
zones.floor: path from about 277 m to 290 m
zones.collision: path is a deck; tree trunks and rock are posts/solids; no off-path walking

zones.name: 岩口
zones.collision: cave walls/roof are solids; the stair is a ramp; the mouth is a threshold, not a door

zones.name: 木楼下部
zones.floor: cave floor about 300 m; platform at +6.5 m
zones.collision: platform is a roof overhead; the pillar and short posts are posts; the cave floor is not walkable except the marked path

zones.name: 侧向栈道
zones.collision: walkway is a deck; railing is a post line; the edge is not a drop (v1)

zones.name: 上层小殿
zones.collision: hall is a solid with a door; the altar is a post rectangle; the back wall meets the rock

route.climb_m: about 25 m (lake 275 m to upper hall 309 m); proposal, not survey data
route.note: +x east, +z south; waypoints are a design proposal following the OSM footway and the published plan. The 230 m includes the switchbacks of the 101-step stair; the straight-line waypoints sum shorter. Z0 (the lake view) is camera-only and is not part of the walkable route; the 433 m OSM approach from the northeast is outside the playable route.

checkpoints.system: 岩行记·五记（见 CHECKPOINTS.md）；不做集齐门槛，不评分

lighting.preset: whitebox neutral daylight first; then G01 岩下柔光 (summer-after-rain morning; reconstructed from the atlas entry because the #art page returned 401); autumn-clear-afternoon variant
lighting.main_light: east cave-mouth daylight, 4800-5200 K, diffuse; no direct sun inside the cave; warm red bounce from the Danxia rock
lighting.local_light: one small lamp in the upper hall only; no lamp at noon; no coloured cave lighting
lighting.fog: thin mist outside the mouth only; none inside the cave
lighting.wetness: rock and stone steps wet after rain; timber dry; drip falls on stone, not on timber
